system.description:
Frosted Glass: While occupying an Ice Mirror, all Ice Mirrors, emit a mist, filling a 10-foot radius around them. Allied creatures standing within this mist gain the benefit of Mirrors Protection.

Ominous Reflections: You gain a rank of Mastery to Chakra Control. This increases to two ranks at 11th level. When you take the Suppress Chakra action, you can select an active Ice Mirrors. That Ice Mirrors now emits chakra, making it look like you are occupying it, even if you aren’t.

Brine Prison: When you inflict the Frostbite condition on a creature, that creature releases a pulse of frozen air, freezing the ground around them, making it slippery. The affected creature turns a 10-foot radius, centered on them into difficult terrain for the next minute. You have immunity to this difficult terrain and if an effect that deals fire damage would occur or overlap with the affected area, the difficult terrain is dispelled.
